64M, ELECTIVE admission from PHYSICIAN REFERRAL.
OUTCOME: discharged alive to HOME
PRESENTING SYMPTOMS: Chills (without fever)
PRIMARY DIAGNOSIS: Encounter for antineoplastic chemotherapy
ACTIVE DIAGNOSES: Antineoplastic chemotherapy induced pancytopenia; Mantle cell lymphoma, extranodal and solid organ sites; Other pancytopenia; Essential (primary) hypertension; Hyperlipidemia, unspecified; Obesity, unspecified; Benign prostatic hyperplasia without lower urinary tract symptoms; Anemia in neoplastic disease; Thrombocytopenia, unspecified; Other disorders of phosphorus metabolism
PAST MEDICAL HISTORY: Encounter for antineoplastic chemotherapy; Body mass index [BMI] 31.0-31.9, adult; Personal history of other malignant neoplasm of skin; Family history of malignant neoplasm of digestive organs; Family history of malignant neoplasm of other organs or systems; Personal history of colonic polyps
PROCEDURES: Introduction of Other Antineoplastic into Central Vein, Percutaneous Approach; Drainage of Spinal Canal, Percutaneous Approach, Diagnostic
MEDICATIONS: 0.9% Sodium Chloride 250mL IV; Potassium Phosphate 15mmol IV; Sodium Chloride 0.9%  Flush 3-10mL IV; Simethicone 40mg PO/NG; Bag 1BAG IV; Magnesium Sulfate 4gm IV; LevoFLOXacin 500mg PO; Sodium Bicarbonate 1300mg PO; Potassium Chloride Replacement (Critical Care and Oncology)  80mEq PO/NG; Phosphorus 500mg PO/NG; Enoxaparin (Prophylaxis) 40mg SC; Sterile Water 200mL IV; Potassium Chloride 80mEq IV; 5% Dextrose 1000mL IV; Viaflex Bag 652.2mL IV; Methotrexate 15,680mg IV; Ondansetron 16mg IV; Heparin Flush (10 units/ml) 5mL IV; Leucovorin Calcium 100mg IV; Acyclovir 400mg PO/NG; Heparin Flush (100 units/ml) 5mL IV
MICROBIOLOGY: none
SERVICES: OMED
WARDS: Hematology/Oncology Intermediate
